ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution consisting of approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixels and 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in scars and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black field; high-intensity white clusters localized at both distal tips; numerous discrete white circular and linear motifs distributed irregularly across the medial and lateral zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree interior angle; the vertex is partially obscured by low-intensity water spray but the converging lobe edges define the angle clearly.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes varying between 3-8 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in acute, upwardly-tilted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of white circular ring-shaped pixel clusters (ranging from 10 to 30 pixels in diameter) distributed across the central and lateral regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) present on both lobes, with a high-density lattice pattern visible on the distal third of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of high-contrast, textured white/grey pixels indicating heavy barnacle colonization on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; extensive rake mark scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several prominent 'bullseye' concentric ring scars on the left lobe; dense intersecting rake marks on the right lobe forming a complex geometric texture.
